location_qualifier: beaches west of the Matanikau; assembled by mid-October
composing_text: The division’s three infantry regiments, as named in Miller, chapter VI.
notes: Miller, chapter VI: by mid-October 1942 the 2nd Division was on Guadalcanal and ready to fight beside the survivors of the Ichiki and Kawaguchi Forces. The claim date is mid-month, not a single landing day. Confidence 0.5.
